name: Shop 2 API
author: Adriaan

sections.description:
Shop2API is a service where you can connect your WooCommerce web-shop to Bol.com and Amazon.

The main purpose of this plugin is to integrate Bol.com and Amazon into WooCommerce, it aims to
integrate as much as possible services between the platforms.

Current Services:
– Sync Offers to Bol.com
– Sync Products to Bol.com
– Sync Orders from Bol.com to WooCommerce
– Send Shipments (with optional Track & Trace) to Bol.com
– Sync Stock from WooCommerce to Bol.com
– Re-pricer service
– Sync Orders from Amazon to WooCommerce (Selling Partner API)

Instructions

1) After installing Shop2Api, a new menu item will be available in your WordPress installation, you can continue and click on it and enter your e-mail address.
2) You can use the trail account where start using Shop 2 API without restrictions for 6 months and cancel at anytime by uninstalling the plugin, the plugin will mark the account as inactive if no payment is done after 6 months.
2) After you clicked on the connect button the URL for your WooCommerce connection will be linked to your e-mail. If you need to unlink it, you can mail support@shop2api.com
3) If the connection with the red icon still needs to be connected to your web shop, clicking on the icons will open the connection screens.
4) You can click on the WooCommerce icon, and you will be rerouted to the WooCommerce permission screen as below.
5) When you click on the Bol Icon the above screen will open where you can enter your client id and secret.
5a) When you click on the Amazon Icon, enter your Selling Partner API refresh token, choose your marketplace and (for testing) tick Use Sandbox. See https://shop2api.com/faq/amazon-api-setup for how to obtain your refresh token.
6) Map Woocommerce Sections to Bol
WooCommerce have Categories, Tags, Attributes and Metadata, this is to group your data logically and will be used for groupings in Bol.

Here you would want to map which WooCommerce Grouping to Bol’s Grouping
Ex. Behang Tag on WC ⇒ Behang on Bol

7) Map Woocommerce Fields to Bol Fields
This is the field mappings you want to map to bol

1) Description and link updates

1) URL Update

1.0.33.0

1) Updated Tested version to 7.0
2) Update requirements to PHP 7.4

1.0.33.3

1) Added Security and version updates

1.0.32.4

1) WooCommerce Product Field dropdown is now hardcoded in the plugin and sorted alphabetically, removing the backend API dependency
2) WooCommerce Attribute dropdown now fetches directly from WooCommerce via wc_get_attribute_taxonomies(), sorted alphabetically
3) WooCommerce Metadata dropdown now fetches directly from the local WordPress database, sorted alphabetically
4) Mapping page no longer requires a backend call to retrieve WooCommerce field options on page load

1.0.33.5

1) Added token update block to the Support card on the dashboard
2) Removed Sync Summary Offers, Sync Summary Products, and Sync Summary Orders blocks from the dashboard

1.0.33.6

1) Token update fix.

1.0.33.7

1) Added token entry to the registration modal so existing tokens can be entered when no token is stored

1.0.33.8

1) Save Token button now binds before settings-dependent code so it works even when no token is stored
2) Current token display now rendered server-side to remove JS dependency
3) Reverted registration modal changes

1.0.33.9

1) Fixed double forward slash in asset URLs caused by trailing slash in plugin_dir_url() combined with leading slash in asset paths

1.0.33.10

1) Subscription Changes

1.0.34.0

1) Added “Send shipment to Bol.com” button on the WooCommerce order edit page, with an optional Carrier and Track & Trace, which adds an order note on success
2) Added a “Ship/Check Orders” button to the dashboard Support card to manually pull new Bol.com orders into WooCommerce
3) “Sync Stock to Bol.com” now defaults to enabled on the order sync page
4) Removed the Current Token / Update Token debug block from the Support card

1.0.35.0

1) Added Amazon integration – connect your Amazon shop on the dashboard with your Selling Partner API refresh token, choose your marketplace, and toggle the Sandbox environment for testing
2) Added Sync Orders from Amazon to WooCommerce (products missing in WooCommerce are auto-created from the Amazon SellerSKU)
3) Renamed the “Sync Order Report” page to “Orders Synced” and it now lists both Bol.com and Amazon orders together, with a Platform column
4) The dashboard “Check Orders” button now pulls new orders from both Bol.com and Amazon
5) Added Retry / Stop actions for Amazon orders on the Orders Synced page
6) Renamed the dashboard “Webshop Connection Information” card to “Partner Details”, which now stays visible after the connections succeed
7) Added an Amazon API setup guide (find it at https://shop2api.com/faq/amazon-api-setup)

1.0.35.1

1) Standardized the WooCommerce, Bol.com and Amazon connection logos to a uniform size on the dashboard
2) Menu items and the dashboard connection check now appear when either Bol.com or Amazon is connected (previously required Bol.com)
